tools.name: status
tools.description: Returns this session's plan rate-limit usage as JSON, from the last API response: `windows` keyed by kind (five_hour, seven_day, and any other window reported except the spend limit), each with `used_percentage`, `resets_at` and `verdict`; an overall `verdict`, the worst window's (`quiet`, `approach` at or above `approach_pct`, `edge` at or above `line_threshold`, or `unknown` when no window is reported); those two thresholds and `lanes_pause_edge`; and `spend_limit` when a gateway reports one. A window whose reset time has passed is left out. The figures change only when an API response arrives. By default rate-limit-guard also adds a line to the next prompt or tool result when the 5-hour or 7-day window rises to approach or edge, or resets from edge. Read-only.
